subject: CHEMISTRY
purpose: Promote PR #346's teacher-helper language rule into a machine-checkable contract. A hint that only names a concept — 'use the definition', 'apply the mole method' — is invalid. A valid hint says what to write, draw, count, cancel, compare, label or test next, and the learner can act on it with a pencil.

WRITE_RELATION.produces: A relation or equation written down with the given quantities substituted.
WRITE_RELATION.example_good: Write n = m/M, put the given mass on top and the molar mass underneath.

WRITE_SPECIES_OR_FORMULA.produces: A species, formula, equation or label written or marked on paper.
WRITE_SPECIES_OR_FORMULA.example_good: Write Ca²⁺ and PO₄³⁻ side by side, then write the counts that make the charges cancel.

COUNT_FEATURE.produces: A count of a named feature, written down.
COUNT_FEATURE.example_good: Count H and O atoms separately on both sides of the equation.

CANCEL_UNIT.produces: A struck-out unit and a named surviving unit.
CANCEL_UNIT.example_good: Cancel g top and bottom; the unit left should be mol.

COMPARE_QUANTITY.produces: Two named things placed side by side and a stated difference.
COMPARE_QUANTITY.example_good: Notice where the numeral is written: upper right or lower right?

TEST_DEFINITION.produces: A stated criterion applied to the case in front of the learner.
TEST_DEFINITION.example_good: First split the entries into mixtures and pure substances, then ask of each pure substance: one kind of atom, or different elements joined in a fixed ratio?
TEST_DEFINITION.example_bad: Use the definition to classify the substances.

VERIFY_RESULT.produces: A named check run against the learner's own working.
VERIFY_RESULT.example_good: Check that the same species appears on both sides before accepting the answer.

non_actionable_patterns: ^\s*(think about|be careful|pay attention|take care|keep in mind)\b
\b(elicit|scaffold the learner|show the learner|present to the learner|teach the learner)\b

H0_ATTEMPT_FIRST.note: H0 is not a content hint: its job is to make the learner attempt the question before any support is opened. It must instruct that attempt explicitly, and it may not be a description of the pedagogy.

H1_NOTICE.note: H1 must name the specific feature to look at, not the topic.

H2_RULE_MODEL_REPRESENTATION.note: H2 is allowed to be a statement, because its job is to supply the rule or model. It must state the rule's content; naming a rule without stating it is NON_ACTIONABLE_HINT.

H3_START.note: H3 must be the first concrete move on paper.

CORE1_CONCEPT_HELPER.note: The Core 1 'if you get stuck' helper must produce an observable action, not restate what a good hint would do.

FORMULA_ANATOMY_AND_CHARGE.helper_text: Copy the formula out with space around each part, then circle the number in front, each low number and any raised charge before you try to read what it means.

SUBSCRIPT_COEFFICIENT_CHARGE_DISCRIMINAT.helper_text: Circle the number you are unsure about and say where it sits: in front of the formula, low down after a symbol, or raised up after it.

MACRO_PARTICLE_SYMBOLIC_TRANSLATION.helper_text: Count the separate particles you can actually see and write that number down before you write any symbols.

CONSERVATION_ATOM_CHARGE_SPECIES.helper_text: Draw two columns, give each element its own row, and count that element on the left and on the right before you compare anything.

RULE_PRIORITY_AND_EXCEPTION.helper_text: Underline the condition written with the reaction, then ask whether the usual rule still holds while that condition is there.

OBSERVATION_EVIDENCE_CLAIM.helper_text: Write the observation on one line exactly as it was recorded, write your claim on the line under it, and draw an arrow from one to the other.

REACTION_PROCESS_CLASSIFICATION.helper_text: Write down the single observation that decides this, then test it against the rule before you write any label.

SPECIES_ROLE_AND_SPECTATOR.helper_text: List the starting substances down the left and the finishing ones down the right, then join each substance to itself with a line before you name any role.

STRUCTURE_SITE_REASONING.helper_text: Label each site in the structure with its own letter, then work on one lettered site at a time.

PRACTICAL_METHOD_PROPERTY_LINK.helper_text: Write down which property is being used, then decide which part of the apparatus uses it.

CHEMICAL_VERIFICATION.helper_text: List the checks that apply as short lines, then tick them off one at a time against your own working.

MISCONCEPTION_MINIMAL_CONTRAST.helper_text: Predict both answers before you look, then find the one feature that differs between them.

FIRST_MOVE_DECISION_SUPPORT.helper_text: Write down what the question is asking for, then write the one piece of information you still need in order to get there.

REDOX_OXIDATION_STATE_LANES.helper_text: Write the oxidation number above the element before the change and above the same element after it, then compare the two numbers.

REDOX_SELF_OTHER_AGENT_LOGIC.helper_text: Write what this substance did to itself on one line and what it did to the other substance on the next, then name it.

REDOX_SPLIT_CONVERGE_TOPOLOGY.helper_text: Mark the same element on every branch with its oxidation number, then see whether one value splits into two or two values meet at one.

MATTER_COMPOSITION_CLASSIFICATION.helper_text: Ask first whether the sample is one substance or a mix; if it is one substance, ask whether it holds one kind of atom or several joined in a fixed ratio.

FIXED_COMPOSITION_EVIDENCE.helper_text: Work out the mass ratio for each sample in its own row, then compare the rows before you decide.

UNIT_SCALE_AND_DIMENSIONAL_REASONING.helper_text: Write the quantity with its unit, multiply by the conversion factor the question gives you, and strike out the unit that appears both top and bottom.

CHARGE_NEUTRALITY_FORMULA_CONSTRUCTION.helper_text: Write both ions with their charges, then count how many of each you need so the plus total and the minus total cancel exactly.

ENTITY_COUNTING_AND_ATOMICITY.helper_text: Expand the bracket first, then count each atom or ion in one formula unit and write the totals down.

RELATIVE_MASS_COMPOSITION.helper_text: Write one row per element as count times relative atomic mass, then add the rows up.

MASS_MOLE_ENTITY_BRIDGE.helper_text: Write n = m/M, put the given mass on top and the molar mass underneath, then check that g cancels and mol is what is left.

CONCENTRATION_PART_WHOLE.helper_text: Write the part on top, then say out loud whether the bottom is the whole solution or only the solvent before you divide.

STOICHIOMETRIC_RATIO_ROUTE.helper_text: Circle the number in front of what you are given and the number in front of what you want, then write them as a fraction the right way up.

hint_duplicates_solution_rule: A hint may not reproduce the spelled-out final answer (H0/H1/H3) and may not reproduce a solution reasoning step verbatim (any stage).
answer_leak_scope_note: The spelled-out-answer leak check runs on H0, H1 and H3. It deliberately does not run on H2, because H2 exists to supply the rule, and for a notation-meaning item ("what does the raised 2- mean?") the rule and the answer necessarily overlap; failing H2 there would punish the hint for doing its job. The verbatim-solution-step check still runs on every stage, and the candidate-level hints_distinct_from_solution gate still covers the coarse case.
